definitions.explanation: Damage, irritation, or wear caused by repeated rubbing or friction on a surface. Applies to skin (chafing), fabric (wear), or other materials.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}{擦|ず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a blister from my shoes rubbing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{襟|えり}→襟：06487_eri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: The wear on the collar has become noticeable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{太|ふと}もも→太もも：16733_futomomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{擦|す}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}き→起きる：00521_okiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When running long distances, chafing tends to occur on the inner thighs.

notes:
The noun form of {擦|す}れる (to rub, to chafe). Frequently appears in compounds and is an everyday word for physical wear caused by friction. The reading changes to ⟦ずれ→ずれ：10044_zure⟧ in some compounds (e.g., {靴|くつ}ずれ).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴|くつ}{擦|ず}れ: shoe blister, shoe rubbing
- {擦|す}れ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: abrasion, scrape wound
- {擦|す}れて⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: hurts from rubbing
- {股|また}{擦|ず}れ: inner thigh chafing
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}れ: wear on sleeves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{摩擦|まさつ}→摩擦：00271_masatsu⟧: friction — the physical force itself, more technical and scientific
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: wound, scratch — broader term for any damage or injury
- {磨耗|まもう}: wear, abrasion — more technical, used for mechanical or material wear
